title: Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs) & Autonomous Agentic Workflows
workplace_track: Emerging Tech: AI & Industrial Machine Learning
description: Advanced artificial intelligence module covering foundation LLMs (Gemini, GPT-4, Claude), multi-head attention mechanisms, context windows, and autonomous agentic loops.
learning_objectives: Master frontier AI terminology (transformers, self-attention, context windows, RAG, agentic loops, quantization)
Apply inverted conditionals and mandative subjunctive in enterprise AI governance
Demonstrate precision when drafting AI deployment policies, privacy guardrails, and latency SLAs

questions.prompt: _____ AI researchers not introduced multi-head self-attention mechanisms in 2017, large language models would have remained computationally intractable.

explanations.correct: Inverted Third Conditional 'Had AI researchers not introduced...' correctly expresses a past counterfactual premise without 'if'.
explanations.wrong_A: 'If' requires the auxiliary 'had' after the subject.
explanations.wrong_C: 'Were' forms a Second Conditional, incompatible with past 'would have remained'.

questions.cz_learning_point: Inverze 3. kondicionálu v odborném textu: 'Had researchers not introduced...' = 'Kdyby vědci bývali nezavedli...'. V podmínce se nepoužívá 'if' ani 'would'.
questions.workplace_track: Emerging Tech: AI & Industrial Machine Learning

questions.prompt: Under no circumstances _____ autonomous software agents be granted unrestricted delete privileges on live industrial SCADA databases.

explanations.correct: Negative introductory phrase 'Under no circumstances' triggers subject-auxiliary inversion: 'should autonomous [agents be granted]'.
explanations.wrong_A: 'agents should' lacks the required subject-auxiliary inversion.
explanations.wrong_B: 'must to' is ungrammatical; modal 'must' does not take 'to'.

questions.cz_learning_point: Záporná úvodní fráze 'Under no circumstances' vyžaduje převrácený slovosled (inverzi): 'Under no circumstances should autonomous agents be granted...'.
questions.workplace_track: Emerging Tech: AI & Industrial Machine Learning

questions.prompt: If the engineering department had implemented a robust retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) vector database, the enterprise model _____ hallucinations today.

explanations.correct: Mixed conditional: past cause ('had implemented') with present ongoing result ('today') takes 'would not be generating'.
explanations.wrong_B: 'would not have generated' refers purely to past result, but adverbial 'today' anchors the result to the present.
explanations.wrong_C: 'will not generate' is First Conditional, incompatible with past counterfactual condition.
explanations.wrong_D: Indicative 'does not generate' cannot express hypothetical consequence.

questions.cz_learning_point: Smíšený kondicionál (Mixed Conditional): minulá příčina spojená s přítomným následkem: 'If they had implemented [minulost], it would not be generating [dnes]'.
questions.workplace_track: Emerging Tech: AI & Industrial Machine Learning

questions.prompt: Enterprise cybersecurity policies mandate that every generative AI pipeline _____ strict data loss prevention (DLP) sanitization on user prompts.

explanations.correct: Mandative subjunctive after 'mandate that' requires base form 'execute' regardless of 3rd person singular subject.
explanations.wrong_A: Indicative 'executes' with 3rd person -s violates mandative subjunctive syntax.
explanations.wrong_B: Future 'will execute' is incorrect after mandative 'mandate that'.

questions.cz_learning_point: Subjunktiv po slovesech nařízení a bezpečnostních pravidel (mandate that every pipeline execute): sloveso zůstává v základním tvaru bez -s.
questions.workplace_track: Emerging Tech: AI & Industrial Machine Learning

questions.prompt: _____ the foundational model down to 4-bit precision via AWQ quantization, engineers deployed the LLM directly onto local edge server hardware.

explanations.correct: Perfect active participle 'Having quantized' correctly expresses an optimization completed prior to local edge deployment.
explanations.wrong_A: Base form 'Quantize' cannot function as introductory participle.
explanations.wrong_B: Past form 'Quantized' without auxiliary is passive, but engineers actively performed the quantization.
explanations.wrong_D: 'Being quantized' expresses present passive, not completed prior action.

questions.cz_learning_point: Předpřítomné participium (Having quantized = poté, co kvantizovali...) vyjadřuje děj dokončený před hlavní větou.
questions.workplace_track: Emerging Tech: AI & Industrial Machine Learning

questions.prompt: _____ impressive performance on benchmark coding exams, commercial LLMs frequently hallucinate syntax when handling proprietary legacy protocols.

explanations.correct: 'Notwithstanding' is a formal preposition followed by a noun phrase ('impressive performance on benchmark coding exams').
explanations.wrong_A: 'Although' is a conjunction and must be followed by a full finite clause.
explanations.wrong_D: 'Even though' requires a full clause with subject and verb.

questions.cz_learning_point: 'Notwithstanding' (navzdory / i přes) se pojí s podstatným jménem, zatímco spojky jako 'Although' a 'Even though' vyžadují celou větu se slovesem.
questions.workplace_track: Emerging Tech: AI & Industrial Machine Learning

questions.prompt: Deep neural networks with transformer architectures are widely acknowledged _____ natural language processing capabilities over the past decade.

explanations.correct: Perfect active infinitive 'to have transformed' correctly attributes a historic completed breakthrough to transformer networks.
explanations.wrong_A: Present infinitive 'to transform' fails to indicate past completion.
explanations.wrong_B: Participle 'transforming' cannot follow passive reporting verb 'are acknowledged'.
explanations.wrong_C: Passive 'to have been transformed' incorrectly treats neural networks as the object rather than the driving agent.

questions.cz_learning_point: Vazba 'are acknowledged to have transformed' (uznává se, že transformovaly) vyjadřuje minulý děj pomocí minulého infinitivu.
questions.workplace_track: Emerging Tech: AI & Industrial Machine Learning

questions.prompt: Only after fine-tuning the model on specialized manufacturing SOP manuals _____ accurate technical troubleshooting recommendations.

explanations.correct: Limiting introductory phrase 'Only after...' triggers subject-auxiliary inversion with Past Simple: 'did the assistant generate'.
explanations.wrong_B: 'the assistant generated' lacks required subject-auxiliary inversion.
explanations.wrong_C: 'generated the assistant' is archaic full inversion without auxiliary 'did'.
explanations.wrong_D: Present perfect conflicts with completed past fine-tuning.

questions.cz_learning_point: Zdůrazňující úvodní vazba 'Only after...' vyžaduje inverzní slovosled: 'Only after fine-tuning did the assistant generate...'.
questions.workplace_track: Emerging Tech: AI & Industrial Machine Learning

questions.prompt: An artificial intelligence model exhibiting an inference latency exceeding eight seconds _____ for high-speed industrial sorting automation.

explanations.correct: 'Cannot possibly be suitable' expresses absolute deductive impossibility based on latency constraints.
explanations.wrong_A: 'must not' expresses prohibition or deduction of absence, but lacks impossibility nuance.
explanations.wrong_B: 'should not' expresses moral obligation or advice.

questions.cz_learning_point: Vyjádření naprosté nemožnosti: 'cannot possibly be suitable' (v žádném případě nemůže být vhodný pro vysokorychlostní linky).
questions.workplace_track: Emerging Tech: AI & Industrial Machine Learning

questions.prompt: The AI research consortium open-sourced a multi-agent framework, under the terms of _____ commercial enterprises may build autonomous applications.

explanations.correct: Formal prepositional relative phrase 'under the terms of which' strictly takes 'which' when modifying a license or framework.
explanations.wrong_A: 'that' cannot follow a preposition in formal relative clauses.

questions.cz_learning_point: Po předložkách v rozvitých vztažných větách se pro software a licence používá výhradně 'which': 'under the terms of which' (podle jehož podmínek).
questions.workplace_track: Emerging Tech: AI & Industrial Machine Learning
